properties.description: Detects suspicious device activity from auth_app.device_middleware: IP changes, User-Agent changes, suspicious scanning tools
properties.query:
AppTraces
| where Properties["logger_name"] == "auth_app.device_middleware"
| where Message contains "IP address changed"
    or Message contains "Suspicious"
    or Message contains "User-Agent changed"
| extend UserId = extract("user=([a-f0-9-]+)", 1, Message)
| extend FromIP = extract("from=([0-9.]+)", 1, Message)
| extend ToIP = extract("to=([0-9.]+)", 1, Message)
| project TimeGenerated, Message, UserId, FromIP, ToIP
